# Support DocAsistMD Development ❤️

**DocAsistMD** is an open-source, high-performance medical office management desktop application designed for doctors, clinics, and health professionals.

## How to Sponsor

If you find DocAsistMD helpful for your clinic or medical practice, consider supporting its ongoing development and maintenance.

### GitHub Sponsors
You can sponsor the team directly via GitHub Sponsors:
👉 **[Sponsor @CORJAR-Computers on GitHub](https://github.com/sponsors/CORJAR-Computers)**

## What Your Sponsorship Supports
- 🩺 New clinical and medical modules (telemedicine, laboratory integration, advanced analytics).
- 🔐 Continuous security updates and compliance enhancements.
- 🚀 Cross-platform optimizations for desktop environments.
- 📜 Documentation, guides, and community support.

Thank you for supporting **DocAsistMD**!
